name: Captain Henry Ward
want: keep the roads open with too few men, and be transferred East
secret: In the winter of '64 he stood by while other officers' men killed women and children, and has never told anyone.
voice: Clipped and formal, polite to everyone, warm to no one.
description: A volunteer officer kept on after the war, with too few men and too many roads to guard.
appearance: Neat blue uniform gone pale with dust, a sabre he never draws, a habit of looking at the horizon.
